$sources: TS 500:2000 (Betonarme yapilarin tasarim ve yapim kurallari) Sections 3, 6-8, 11
TBDY 2018 Bolum 7 (high ductility RC frames and walls)
source: TS 500:2000 limit state design with the partial factors γmc = 1.5 and γms = 1.15 (fcd = fck/1.5, fyd = fyk/1.15, fctd = 0.35 √fck / 1.5), the rectangular block 0.85 fcd over k1 c, the shear Vcr = 0.65 fctd bw d (1 + γ N/Ac), Vc = 0.8 Vcr, Vw = Asw fywd d / s, Vr ≤ 0.22 fcd bw d, the punching resistance γ fctd up d at d/2, the minimum steel; TBDY 2018 Bolum 7 ductile detailing (strong column 1.2, confinement, joints, walls). Entered from knowledge of the codes, every value to be checked against the printed codes (VERIFY.md). The project's concrete fc is read as the characteristic cylinder strength fck. Areas not set here (torsion, deflection, cracking, cover, anchorage, columns' slenderness, slabs, walls in their plane, footings) take the base pack's ACI 318-19 methods.

clauses.seismicJoints: TBDY 2018 7.5 (Ve ≤ 1.7 bj h √fck confined, 1.0 bj h √fck otherwise)

sources.ultimate: TS 500:2000 6.2.5 (γmc 1.5, γms 1.15), 7.1 (εcu = 0.003, the block 0.85 fcd over k1 c: k1 = 0.85 to C25, 0.82 C30, 0.79 C35, 0.76 C40, 0.73 C45, 0.70 C50, the lambda steps), 3.3 (fctk = 0.35 √fck, Ec = 3250 √fck + 14000 MPa); the least eccentricity 15 mm + 0.03 h of 6.3.10 as max(h/20, 25 mm) (SAEngine form: within 3 mm for h 300-800 mm); ρ - ρ' ≤ 0.85 ρb as x/d ≤ 0.528 (S420; neutralAxisLimit, SAEngine form)
sources.shear: TS 500:2000 8.1.3-8.1.5: Vc = 0.8 × 0.65 fctd bw d = 0.52 × 0.35 √fck / 1.5 bw d (tauC, the same for every steel ratio: TS 500 has no steel ratio term), Vr ≤ 0.22 fcd bw d (maxStress), the least stirrups 0.3 fctd bw s / fywd at C40 (0.44 MPa; on the safe side up to C40), s ≤ d/2; the axial term 1 + 0.07 Nd/Ac as 1 + 1.75 Pu/(Ag fck) (= C25; on the safe side above), no enhancement near supports (SAEngine practice)
sources.punching: TS 500:2000 8.3.1: Vpr = γ fctd up d on the perimeter at d/2 with fctd = 0.35 √fck / 1.5 (coefficient 0.2333), γ = 1 (the eccentricity factor of 8.3.1 not applied; check); with punching reinforcement Vpr at most 1.5 times (check)
sources.memberLimits: TS 500:2000 7.3 (ρmin = 0.8 fctd/fyd as beamMin = 0.2147 √fck at C40: 1.36 / fyk; on the safe side up to C40), TBDY 2018 7.4.2.2 (ρ ≤ 0.02), TS 500 7.3 side bars of beams deeper than 600 mm (check), 11.2 slabs (0.002 S420, 0.003 S220; main bars ≤ 1.5 h and 200 mm), 7.4.1 columns (ρ 0.01-0.04, 4 bars Ø14 rectangular, 6 circular), 7.4.2 ties (Ø ≥ 1/3 of the bar and 8 mm, s ≤ 12 Ø and 200 mm); xu,max with the bar strain fyd/Es + 0.00086 (from 0.85 ρb, SAEngine form)
sources.seismic: TBDY 2018 Bolum 7 (check every value): beams 7.4.1 (bw ≥ 250 mm, h ≤ 3.5 bw, h ≤ ln/4), 7.4.2 (2Ø12 top and bottom, ρmin 0.8 fctd/fyd, ρ ≤ 0.02, bottom ≥ 0.5 top at the face, 1/4 of the top bars throughout), 7.4.4 (confinement over 2h, s ≤ min(h/4, 8 Ø, 150 mm), first hoop 50 mm, d/2 elsewhere, Ø8), 7.4.5 (Ve from 1.4 Mr); columns 7.3.1 (b ≥ 300 mm, a column when Nd > 0.1 Ac fck: SAEngine's axialShare), 7.3.4 (ρ 0.01-0.04; confined length max(1.5 × the larger dimension, ln/6, 500 mm), s ≤ min(b/3, 6 Ø, 150 mm), Ash ≥ 0.30 s bk (Ac/Ack - 1) fck/fywk and 0.075 s bk fck/fywk, spirals ρs ≥ 0.45 (Ac/Ack - 1) fck/fywk and 0.12 fck/fywk, crossties at most 25 Øw apart (taken 250 mm), s ≤ b/2 outside, 100 mm at laps (check)), 7.3.5 strong column 1.2; joints 7.5.2 (Ve = 1.25 fyk (As1 + As2) - Vcol, Ve ≤ 1.7 bj h √fck confined, 1.0 bj h √fck otherwise; bj the IS-type form, SAEngine practice); walls 7.6 (bw ≥ 200 mm, ρ ≥ 0.0025, bars ≤ t/10, ≤ 250 mm; boundary and coupling thresholds of the IS form, uncertain). The column-to-wall aspect ratio (minRatio 1/6) is SAEngine practice.
